detail.longDescription:
Get ready and enjoy the best Hidden object adventure escape game with intuitive puzzles and unique storyline of a spy. Use your intelligence to solve the mission. 
The world is about to launch into a nuclear war. Do you have it in you to stop it? Can you solve the secrets of Zoshea with Agent Falcon. 

Start your journey with agent Falcon:-
Meet Agent Falcon, a rookie but a very talented secret agent who is about to take on a thrilling espionage mission to the elusive militaristic country of Zoshea. Zoshea is ruled by a ruthless dictator known as the Supreme President who is set to wreak terror upon the world!  Hidden Escape: Spy Agent is a free adventure escape game where you need to find hidden objects, get clues, and move ahead in the game. 

Immerse yourself into the mysteries of Zoshea’s ruthless dictator:-
- Uncover the secrets of Zoshea
- Team-up with allies 
- Use your intelligence and find clues 
- Solve puzzles and mini games. 

Game Highlights/Features:-
- Experience life as an elite secret spy agent
- An original and gripping storyline!
- 8 Unique levels to play
- Solve challenging puzzles and riddles
- Collect tools and build weapons to help you escape
- Use your incredible sniper skills
- Download the whole game for free. Use your skills to complete the game without any purchase

Experience the Ultimate Adventure:-
- More than 80 complex puzzles to solve
- Crack intricate codes
- Decode secret messages and find the hidden agenda

Dive into a perilous land and stop the dictator from executing his sinister plans. Join millions of thrilled adventure escape players and stop global destruction! Agent Falcon must sneak behind enemy lines, infiltrate dictator’s highly secure home, find the rebel leader, sleuth attack enemy soldiers and discover the location of a secret nuclear plant. This elite spy mission isn’t easy and Agent Falcon has little time or training to his side. Together, along with the help of an over-serious SIS chief and a visionary rebel leader, Agent Falcon must race against time to stop the dictator. 

About Company: -
Vincell Studio is an indie mobile gaming studio that houses a team of seriously talented artists, designers, animators, and developers. Everyone at heart is a hardcore gamer with a goal to create unique and exciting games that draw in players from every milieu and across age groups. Our passion for games speaks through the compelling storylines, fascinating visuals and extraordinary puzzles that we labor over and create.
